variants.title: Band gap and ideality factor of a germanium diode
variants.unknown: the band gap, the ideality factor and the saturation current
variants.note: A germanium junction is closer to ideal (n about 1.1) and its saturation current is far larger than silicon's, so it is driven at 1 and 10 mA. Eg0 = 0.782 eV is the linear extrapolation of the germanium gap to 0 K (Sze, from memory - verify); n and I0 are illustrative values of this diode.

source.title: S. M. Sze, Physics of Semiconductor Devices
